      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "a transaction is marked as received when it has not actually been received",
      "quote": "Why replace Remove() with MarkReceived() here? The transaction has not been actually received.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by author rename to MarkResolved and confirmed by ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4053474530",
        "rc:4057945725"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK dad979bf010adeed16d9eebe9fb822f5c519b90c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4048399561",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "remove transactions only when reaching m_max_transactions to avoid needing NodeDisconnected",
      "quote": "What about removing transactions from the list only when the size of the list reaches `m_max_transactions`?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "initially adopted by author, then reverted following discussion with mzumsande",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4057947606",
        "rc:4078567433"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4057947606",
      "status_by_quote": "Done. Removed `NodeDisconnected`. This simplifies it :thumbsup:."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4048983149",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "the send_limit counter is incremented for a stale transaction even if it still has unused allowance",
      "quote": "This increments the send_limit counter for a transaction that came from GetStale() and is acceptable in the mempool. However such a transaction might still have unused \"allowance\".",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added check before granting retry connection, confirmed by ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4057960788"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK dad979bf010adeed16d9eebe9fb822f5c519b90c"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4056094041",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "drop the NumToOpenAdd(1) call as remaining connections or stale retry logic will suffice",
      "quote": "we do not need the NumToOpenAdd(1) call here at all.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained why NumToOpenAdd is necessary and reviewer approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4057435531"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5263963620",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "a resolved transaction cannot be resent or scheduled again even though it is no longer queued or actively broadcast",
      "quote": "This is a weird situation for the user: Trying to resend a transaction is refused with \"Ignoring unnecessary request to schedule an already scheduled transaction\"",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author reverted to clearing resolved entries on Add and vasild approved",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4078549162"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5291953863",
      "status_by_quote": "ACK e2a6665e8719ecc5ccd9ed03d3880c5543a15797"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4061217416",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "test that new connections are opened after receiving the transaction when the proxy is temporarily down",
      "quote": "Would be nice if we can test that new connections are established/opened as well, after receiving the transaction.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added the requested functional test",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4078557688"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4078557688",
      "status_by_quote": "Added the test."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4065921818",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "retry logic becomes effectively dead code because reaching 1000 resend attempts takes impractically long",
      "quote": "Now the retry is basically dead code, since it will take a long time until 1000 resend attempts are reached - I think it might as well be removed.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "dropped by reviewer with code review ACK after author reverted Add behavior",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "r:5340903797",
      "status_by_quote": "Code Review ACK e2a6665e8719ecc5ccd9ed03d3880c5543a15797"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4066000330",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "transactions are kept in memory indefinitely until node restart or maximum limit, increasing resource usage",
      "quote": "This would lead to a potential unexpected increase in resource usage - before, we'd only keep transactions while they were in flight, and the shared pointer would be released",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author reverted to clearing entries at start of Add and reviewer gave code review ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5788112713",
        "rc:4067384104",
        "rc:4078567433"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "rc:4071680127"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5340903797",
      "status_by_quote": "Code Review ACK e2a6665e8719ecc5ccd9ed03d3880c5543a15797"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4066104589",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "a peer disconnecting without answering pong could cause Remove() to steal connection retry slots from unrelated transactions",
      "quote": "now a peer that completed the handshake (`fDisconnect=true`) but doesn't answer the pong would not get a `peer_ack`, but also wouldn't get a try back, so if we then call `Remove()` it could steal slot",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author updated Remove accounting and reviewer gave code review ACK",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5788112713",
        "rc:4078568608"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5340903797",
      "status_by_quote": "Code Review ACK e2a6665e8719ecc5ccd9ed03d3880c5543a15797"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5796471506",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "whether this PR is intended for backport",
      "quote": "is this intended for backport?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed intention to merge and backport before release",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5796618449"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5796618449",
      "status_by_quote": "ideally this can get merged and backported before release."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4083240831",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "potential integer underflow if code is changed in the future",
      "quote": "It is correct now. But because we do not know how this code will be changed in the future, it would be more robust to guard against an underflow here",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author guarded against underflow in push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4157220072"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5934760539",
      "status_by_quote": "Guard against integer underflow in `Remove`"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4124064031",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "extend the fuzz test to call MarkResolved() and NodeDisconnected() to match node behavior",
      "quote": "would be nice if the fuzz test would also call `MarkResolved()` and `NodeDisconnected()`, so it covers the actual way private broadcast works in the node.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added the methods to the fuzz test",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4157250416"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5934760539",
      "status_by_quote": "Added `MarkResolved` and `NodeDisconnected` to fuzz test"
    }
  ],
